hook: Your night sky here flashes with lightning hundreds of nights a year.
title: The Sky That Has Lightning Hundreds of Nights
description:
Where the Catatumbo River meets Lake Maracaibo in Venezuela, thunderstorms light up the night sky on hundreds of nights a year. Sailors once used the flashes as a natural lighthouse. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Venezuela #Geography
